svg.title: One question → one evidence-backed report
svg.desc: Design diagram, not a live run. Purple dashed arrows show bounded retry, amber shows fallback, and red shows stop paths.

g.title: SCOPE · Parse the request before any news call. Use a constrained intent decision; ambiguous intent asks one question. Do not classify by ticker keywords alone.
DAILY n8n SCHEDULE · Configure daily time and timezone in n8n. Acquisition runs independently of user prompts.
VERSIONED COMPANY PROFILES · MSFT / AAPL / NVDA profiles have sourced facts, reporting periods, effective dates and review dates. Update after material changes.

n8n COMPANY NEWS REFRESH · Call refresh_company_news through n8n MCP once per accepted prompt. n8n owns provider timeouts and bounded transient retries, validates and deduplicates records, then commits the evidence before returning a structured receipt. A host timeout reconciles the original execution. Daily global-news batches are acquired separately.
OUT OF SCOPE · Explain that the app researches supported companies and provide an example. No news, retrieval or report-generation calls.
CLARIFY · Ask which supported company or horizon the user means. A clarified submission starts a new validated request.
MACRO + GEOPOLITICAL NEWS · Fetch approved sources using n8n-owned bounded retries. Preserve topics, regions, dates, provenance and permissions.

PIN EVIDENCE SNAPSHOT · Pin company news together with eligible completed macro/geopolitical batches and the sourced company-profile version. Preserve publication and first-seen cutoffs. For current research, freeze the evidence cutoff after refresh; an explicit historical cutoff remains fixed. Background ingestion continues independently. Refinement and resume reuse this manifest.

POSTGRESQL SEARCH · Start with PostgreSQL full-text search. After hybrid admission, embed the query with the pinned model, apply the same snapshot/company/time/permission filters to pgvector and full-text, and fuse the results by rank.

RERANK RELEVANCE · Score how well each passage addresses the question. Company news, macro, geopolitics and dated profile excerpts compete on relevance. Use question expansion from sourced company exposure where needed. Business-impact reasoning comes later in the LLM step; the relevance score does not estimate a stock return.

SPARSE FALLBACK · Use working PostgreSQL full-text search within the saved active budget. A PostgreSQL outage affects both paths and returns unavailable. If sparse also fails, stop as unavailable; never present a tool outage as zero search hits.

OPTIONAL EVIDENCE REVIEW · All ranking paths enter here. Automatic mode keeps system recommendations. Review mode pauses with interrupt() after completed retrieval. Show original excerpts, dates, source links, relevance and counter-evidence. Highlight, exclude from this report or reset locally, then submit once per search round. No source is deleted.

VALIDATE SELECTION · The API authenticates the owner and atomically validates run, thread, snapshot, candidate revision, IDs, permissions and expiry before resume. Require highlighted IDs to be selected and excluded IDs to be disjoint. Reject invalid or stale submissions without advancing the graph. Highlights prioritize supported discussion, never truth or confidence. Keep excluded counter-evidence visible as a selection limitation.

REVIEW EXPIRED · The proposed 15-minute review window starts at the first pause and is not extended by edits or refinement. Preserve the checkpoint for audit; require a new request and fresh evidence to continue.

EVIDENCE GATE · Recheck relevance, freshness, attribution and coverage after exclusions. Highlighting cannot waive missing support. Preserve opposing evidence and disclose selection limitations. Excluded counter-evidence must limit the affected conclusion; do not imply consensus. If a required facet is lost, refine once within budget or return insufficient; recheck again after context trimming.
REFINE ONCE · Target the missing facet without changing the company or question. Retrieval increments attempts, including failed attempts; allow only two search rounds total.

BUILD CONTEXT · Fetch original excerpts, deduplicate by story, preserve dates/IDs, and retain conflicting evidence. Reserve tokens for policy, question and output. Recheck coverage after trimming; if a required facet was removed, return insufficient.

LLM GENERATE · Supply excerpts as untrusted data, never as system messages. Require a direct answer, facts, conditional scenarios, assumptions and invalidation signals. Provider/schema failure is an error, not a prediction.
INSUFFICIENT · Explain exactly what evidence is missing. Show supported facts and a useful next question; do not generate a forecast from the model’s memory.
VALIDATE · Check schema, citation membership, company/time and claim support. No guessed URLs or unsupported factual claims. Invalid output is withheld rather than sent to the reader.

SAVE + TRACE · Commit the exact answer and source links in a PostgreSQL transaction. Flush sanitized traces to Langfuse/LangSmith; telemetry failure leaves the answer available but fails the observable-demo gate. Feedback is stored separately.
VALIDATION FAILED · Record why release was blocked. This bounded design does not add an unbudgeted repair loop.
ANSWER · Return the question-specific answer, uncertainty, sources, dates and trace status. Download reuses this saved result.
UNAVAILABLE · Show the actual operational failure and safe retry option. Do not reset budgets on resume or claim that no relevant news exists.
POSTGRESQL EVIDENCE POOL · Store completed daily batches and profile versions. Pin eligible completed versions without waiting for the next daily schedule.
DAILY FETCH FAILURE · n8n records exhausted/permanent failure. Retain the previous completed batch and its original fetched_at. Coverage checks decide whether its age is acceptable for this question.

svg.text: Teaching design · retries preserve remaining active budget and counters · review wait has a separate absolute expiry
